template.name: Eugene Candle Pattern
template.entry_long: high > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and low > donchian_low_prev(low,{p1}) and close > open
template.exit_long: low < donchian_low_prev(low,{p2}) and high < donchian_high_prev(high,2) and close < open
template.notes: Prior two-bar extremes approximate the current-versus-previous candle breakout and the insider/bird structure; a bullish body classifies the long pattern and the mirrored bearish pattern exits. Zig confirmation, the four-candle state, time filter, and optional price-step protection are unavailable.
